source.title: MRI Machine Supplier in India: A Guide to Choosing the Right Supplier
source.body: Choosing the right MRI machine supplier in India is an important decision for hospitals, diagnostic centres, and healthcare investors. A reliable supplier can help you identify suitable [equipment](https://sashahealthcare.com/evaluate-refurbished-medical-equipment-supplier-india/), understand technical specifications, plan installation, and arrange after-sales support. Sasha HealthCare, based in Hyderabad, Telangana, supplies medical imaging equipment, including refurbished MRI systems, subject to availability. Whether you are establishing a new diagnostic centre or upgrading an existing imaging department, selecting the right MRI system requires careful evaluation of equipment condition, clinical requirements, infrastructure, and long-term operating costs. **What Does an MRI Machine Supplier in India Provide?** An MRI equipment supplier helps healthcare facilities source suitable magnetic resonance imaging systems according to their clinical and operational needs. Depending on the supplier’s capabilities, services may include: **MRI machine sourcing and specification guidance** Transportation and logistics coordination Installation and de-installation coordination Equipment documentation and handover Preventive maintenance and technical support Spare parts and service assistance Before purchasing, confirm which [services ](https://sashahealthcare.com/mri-machine-cost-in-india-complete-buying-guide/)are included in the quotation and which may incur additional charges. **Types of MRI Machines Available** Hospitals can consider different MRI [systems ](https://sashahealthcare.com/how-much-does-an-mri-machine-cost-in-india/)depending on their patient volume, diagnostic requirements, budget, and available infrastructure. **1.5T MRI machines:** These systems are widely used in hospitals and diagnostic centres for a broad range of routine clinical examinations. **3T MRI machines:** These systems offer higher magnetic field strength and may support advanced imaging applications, depending on the configuration and clinical protocols. **Refurbished MRI machines**: Refurbished systems can offer a lower initial investment than comparable new equipment. Buyers should carefully evaluate the machine’s service history, software configuration, coil availability, magnet condition, warranty terms, and spare-parts support. Brands commonly considered by healthcare facilities include Siemens, GE HealthCare, Philips, Canon, and Hitachi, depending on model availability and serviceability. **How to Choose a Reliable MRI Machine Supplier** Before selecting an MRI machine supplier in India, evaluate the following factors: Equipment condition: Request details about the model, manufacturing year, configuration, and maintenance history. Technical inspection: Understand the inspection and acceptance-testing procedures available before handover. Warranty terms: Confirm warranty coverage, exclusions, and the [process ](https://sashahealthcare.com/amc-and-cmc-radiology-services-for-mri-and-ct-scan-machines/)for reporting faults. Installation planning: Check site readiness, room requirements, electrical infrastructure, shielding, and equipment access. After-sales support: Discuss spare parts, preventive maintenance, and technical assistance. Transparent quotation: Request a written breakdown of equipment costs, transportation, installation, and other applicable charges. Comparing suppliers using these criteria helps you assess the overall value of a purchase rather than focusing only on the initial price. **Factors Affecting MRI Machine Price in India** MRI machine prices in India depend on several factors, including field strength, manufacturer, model, age, equipment condition, software, coils, warranty, transportation, and installation requirements. Refurbished MRI systems may reduce the initial investment, but buyers should also consider maintenance expenses, spare-parts availability, infrastructure costs, and long-term serviceability. Request a quotation based on your preferred specifications and clinical requirements. **Why Consider Sasha HealthCare?** Sasha HealthCare is a medical imaging equipment supplier based in Hyderabad, Telangana, serving customers across India. The company assists healthcare facilities with refurbished medical imaging equipment sourcing and relevant logistics, installation coordination, and technical support services, subject to availability. If you are planning to purchase an MRI machine, discuss your requirements, preferred brand, field strength, budget, and installation location before finalising your decision. **Looking for an MRI machine supplier in India?** Contact Sasha HealthCare to discuss available MRI systems and request a quotation.
